entries.title: A review's questions come from the reviewer, in plain words with a picture
entries.body: When an independent review finds something only you can decide, the reviewer that read the change now asks you itself. Each question names what happens now in plain words with a small picture, shows the way it works today and the reviewer's pick, and folds the finding's file and version away. Your choice goes straight to the crewmate building the change.

picture.alt: A Review finding card asking whether an empty meter should still say Later, with a small picture of the meter, a Keep the copy choice tagged As built and a Recommended change.
